_about: aLogs' plug-ins: the one list the app (the button, the sidebar, settings) and the meter (who needs the game reader, who owns which notice) both read. switch: a settings.json pointer, or "meter" for the DPS meter's own switch (overlay_button.json). needs: reader (the meter process reading the game), capture (the app's screen capture), input (aLogs may take control of the game). notices: each notice kind the plug-in owns, with the setting that turns it off (null: only the plug-in's switch). Sanctum Helper's own notice switch lives in its settings (it doesn't hand them over when off). docs/plugins.md explains it all.

plugins.name: DPS meter
plugins.about: The DPS window, the HP labels on the boss bar, the notes on end screens and the "You're being attacked" alert.

plugins.name: Sanctum Helper
plugins.about: The Egg Heist companion: the Lost Sanctum's layout on your map, nests, key rooms and where you are.

plugins.name: Leaderboards
plugins.about: Sends your records to the AniiLogs leaderboards, with the proof automation and your character link.
